questions.stem: How many different patterns can 5 bits hold?
questions.explain: Each bit has 2 choices, so 5 bits give 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 32 patterns.
0110 is 6 and 0111 is 7. Their sum 13 is 1101 in binary.

questions.stem: Let A = {1, 3, 5, 6} and B = {3, 4, 5}. What is A ∩ B?
questions.explain: The intersection keeps only the elements that belong to both sets, which are 3 and 5.
A + A·B = A(1 + B) = A. If A is 1 the OR is already 1, and if A is 0 both terms are 0.

questions.stem: On a K-map, two cells can be grouped when their minterm numbers differ in exactly one bit. Which pair can be grouped?
questions.explain: m5 = 101 and m7 = 111 differ only in the middle bit. The other pairs differ in two or three bits.
